brief: Revise a plan for a stated caregiving period with reduced paid work.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Caregiving Costs"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Planea un periodo de cuidados"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Planeje um período de cuidados"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Revise a plan for a stated caregiving period with reduced paid work.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Caregiving can reduce paid hours and change costs; update a fictional budget for the stated period.
instruction.misconception: Unpaid care has no budget effect, or temporary income loss can be ignored because the old budget balanced.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Use expected paid income during care, include care costs, and check each month before relying on savings or support.
Care costs turn the apparent surplus into a shortfall.
The plan must reflect the changed paid hours.
A repeated monthly gap accumulates across the whole period.
Pending support cannot yet fund a definite payment.
Longer care can increase the cumulative funding gap.
Both income and expense changes affect the revised balance.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Caregiving can reduce paid hours and change costs; update a fictional budget for the stated period.

es-MX.line: Cuidar puede reducir horas pagadas y cambiar costos; actualiza un presupuesto ficticio para el periodo indicado.

pt-BR.line: Cuidar pode reduzir horas pagas e mudar custos; atualize um orçamento fictício para o período dado.

en-US.line: Use expected paid income during care, include care costs, and check each month before relying on savings or support.

es-MX.line: Usa ingreso pagado previsto durante cuidados, incluye sus costos y revisa cada mes antes de depender de ahorros o apoyos.

pt-BR.line: Use renda paga prevista durante cuidados, inclua seus custos e confira cada mês antes de depender de poupança ou apoio.

en-US.scene: Care-period income: 1600; Existing essentials: 1300; Added care costs: 400.
help: Include the added care cost with reduced paid income.

feedback.met: Care costs turn the apparent surplus into a shortfall.
feedback.not_yet: Include the added care cost with reduced paid income.

feedback.met: Costos de cuidado convierten el sobrante aparente en faltante.
feedback.not_yet: Incluye costo nuevo de cuidado con ingreso pagado reducido.

pt-BR.scene: Renda durante cuidados: 1600; Essenciais existentes: 1300; Novos custos de cuidado: 400.

feedback.not_yet: Inclua custo novo de cuidado com renda paga reduzida.

en-US.prompt: Which income belongs in the plan?
en-US.scene: Paid hours will fall during the stated care period.
help: Use confirmed or clearly conditional income assumptions.

feedback.met: The plan must reflect the changed paid hours.
feedback.not_yet: Use confirmed or clearly conditional income assumptions.

help: Usa supuestos de ingreso confirmados o claramente condicionales.

feedback.not_yet: Usa supuestos de ingreso confirmados o claramente condicionales.

pt-BR.scene: Horas pagas cairão durante o período de cuidados dado.
help: Use hipóteses de renda confirmadas ou claramente condicionais.

feedback.met: O plano deve refletir as horas pagas mudadas.
feedback.not_yet: Use hipóteses de renda confirmadas ou claramente condicionais.

en-US.prompt: How much bridges the stated period?
en-US.scene: Monthly gap: 150; Care period: 4 months; Gap stays constant.
help: Multiply the monthly gap by the number of months.

feedback.met: A repeated monthly gap accumulates across the whole period.
feedback.not_yet: Multiply the monthly gap by the number of months.

feedback.not_yet: Multiplica faltante mensual por número de meses.

pt-BR.scene: Falta mensal: 150; Período de cuidados: 4 meses; Falta constante.

feedback.not_yet: Multiplique falta mensal pelo número de meses.

en-US.prompt: How should uncertain support be handled?
en-US.scene: Support is pending with no confirmed amount or start date.

options.label: Mark it conditional; plan the gap

help: Keep uncertain support separate from confirmed available money.

feedback.not_yet: Keep uncertain support separate from confirmed available money.
